summary: Describes NIC user directories at SRI-ARC. It relates to RFCs 620 and 609 about the move of NIC services.

plainLanguage.summary: This notice tells transferred NIC users that their old directories at SRI-ARC would be deleted. It warns them to read network mail there before the deletion.

questions: nic user directories sri arc deletion
what happened to nic directories at sri arc
subtitle: A warning that NIC user directories and mail at SRI-ARC would be deleted during a move.

tldr.problem: NIC users transferred to OFFICE-1 still had directories and mail at SRI-ARC that would soon be removed.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC notifies users that their directories would be deleted on the evening of March 8 and explains that the NIC hostname would point to OFFICE-1.
tldr.outcome: Users were responsible for reading any network mail delivered to them at SRI-ARC before the deletion.

today: The unit metadata lists RFC 621 as Unknown, with no RFC recorded as updating or obsoleting it. It is an administrative notice about the NIC move and directory deletion.

sections.title: Deleting the Old Directories
sections.content: Michael Kudlick announces that directories at SRI-ARC belonging to NIC users transferred to OFFICE-1 would be deleted Friday evening, March 8, 1974. The notice links this change to the host-table update described in RFC 620.
sections.plainLanguage: The NIC users had moved, and their old directories were scheduled for deletion. This notice gives them time to prepare.

sections.title: Where Mail Would Be Delivered
sections.content:
At the same time, the hostname NIC would refer to OFFICE-1 rather than SRI-ARC. Mail addressed as a NIC user at NIC would therefore be delivered to OFFICE-1.

Mail addressed to the same user at SRI-ARC would no longer be accepted there because the user's name would no longer be known at that host.
sections.plainLanguage: After the host-name change, mail sent to NIC would go to OFFICE-1. Mail sent to the user's old SRI-ARC address would not be accepted.

sections.title: Users Must Read Their Mail
sections.content: The notice says users were responsible for reading any Network mail delivered to them at SRI-ARC before Friday evening, March 8. That mail would be deleted at that time.
sections.plainLanguage: Users needed to check their old mail before the deadline. The RFC says that mail would be deleted rather than moved automatically.
